reason: Experimental, capture-plan only, for exact Block Visibility 3.7.1 on single-site WordPress. The settings option and the visibility_preset post type are captured faithfully. The plugin's PRIMARY surface is not: blockVisibility is injected into every registered block (measured 115 of 116 on WP 7.1) and carries entity ids at conditionally-typed nested paths that block_attrs — one top-level key per exact block name, values closed at {int,int[]} — cannot address. Rather than carry a source-local id that lint would not catch (unregistered_block_attr fires only on id/ids/ref-named or *Id-suffixed NUMERIC attributes, and blockVisibility is an object), every block that can hold the attribute declares it a reviewed unsupported boundary, which fires only when a block actually holds it. No deploy/apply evidence exists and none is claimed.

unsupported.reason: WPrism v1 refuses multisite before policy load, so this single-site adapter makes no network claim.

blockVisibility reaches every registered block and nests entity ids at paths whose kind depends on a sibling field. block_attrs binds one top-level key per exact block name over a closed {int,int[]} value vocabulary, so no declaration can rebind them. Declared unsupported on all 115 blocks that can carry it; capture refuses the moment authored content actually holds one. tools/engine-gaps.json records the demand as any_block_structured_attribute_reference_paths.

The visibility_preset meta key control_sets repeats the same conditionally-typed reference structure. The interpreter admits a control set that references no entity and refuses one that does, naming the exact location rule field.

block_visibility_settings is absent until the first save, and the plugin publishes its defaults only through register_setting() on rest_api_init/admin_init, which a capture process does not fire. There is no in-process way to read them from the plugin, so an absent row captures as absence rather than as a hardcoded copy of its defaults.

No target round-trip evidence exists for this capsule. capture-plan is the only admitted conformance mode, and tests/conformance/check.sh refuses so a future mode edit cannot turn a source-only proof into target acceptance.
